methodology.bootstrap: Dataset-level percentile bootstrap with 2,000 deterministic resamples; 95% confidence intervals.
methodology.claimRule: A directional summary requires at least 10 paired datasets, a paired-bootstrap 95% CI above zero, and a two-sided exact sign-test Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 across all generated task-bin comparisons.
methodology.missingness: Missing method-dataset results are excluded, never replaced with zero. Coverage reports the number of datasets contributing to each estimate.
methodology.taxonomy: Decision-interface groups are mutually exclusive. Classification-native and General TSFM are overlapping model-origin lenses; descriptive comparisons involving overlapping lenses are not treated as independent significance claims.
methodology.domain: Domain labels are intentionally unassigned until a curated taxonomy is available; no domain is inferred from dataset names.
